title: Inspect project capabilities and selected current context
description: Expose available executable task contracts and observed project-store standing without selecting a Change or granting authority.
inputs: Explicit project root and selected supported query intent.
outputs: Factual capability/backend standing or bounded selected Change context and explicit limitations.
behavior: Report actual executable operations and interface identity, independently from backend availability.
Inspect only explicit selected operational scope; do not scan or interpret legacy directories as current authority.
Report absent, unavailable and maintenance-fenced state honestly; reads do not initialize or activate a store.

failure_behavior.condition: The associated store is absent, unsupported, corrupt, inaccessible or maintenance-fenced.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report its actual standing without initialization, fallback to legacy directories or inferred authority.

failure_behavior.condition: An explicitly selected query exceeds its bounds or names unavailable content.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return explicit failure or scoped absence; do not silently truncate selected meaning or invent current records.

sources.basis: Functional Analysis of the IR-008 system obligations confirms this distinct published command/record responsibility. The retained CLI/Record Format contract supplies exact public operations and limits; logical behavior is defined before Module allocation.

Assign MOD-010 as the proposed accountable primary responsibility after Functional Analysis. Current product source contracts retain detailed behavior authority; allocation is not runtime adoption or complete AR coverage.
